1-KADR — KEMA IChIDA:

  ALIEN 1: 'What is it?'
  ALIEN 2: 'It is a female human.'
  ALIEN 2: 'And this here is a male human.'

  Tarjimasi:
  1-O'ZGA SAYYORALIK: 'Bu nima?'
  2-O'ZGA SAYYORALIK: 'Bu — urg'ochi odam.'
  2-O'ZGA SAYYORALIK: 'Bu yerdagisi esa —
                       erkak odam.'


RASMDA:
  Uchta o'zga sayyoralik (katta boshli, katta
  qora ko'zli). Ikki odam yorug'lik stolida
  yotibdi.


⚠ 'IT' — ODAM HAQIDA:

  'WHAT IS IT?'
  'IT is a female human.'

  O'zga sayyoraliklar odamlarni 'IT' deb
  ataydi — 'he' yoki 'she' emas!

  Nega? Chunki ular uchun odam — NARSA,
  o'rganish obyekti (hayvon kabi).

  Bu — kitobning nozik badiiy usuli:
  o'zga sayyoraliklarning sovuq, ilmiy
  munosabatini ko'rsatadi.

  Inglizchada 'it' odam haqida faqat:
     • chaqaloq haqida ('The baby — is IT a
       boy or a girl?')
     • noma'lum odam haqida ('Someone is at
       the door. Who is IT?')


DIQQAT — 'FEMALE' va 'MALE':
  female = urg'ochi, ayol jinsi
  male   = erkak jinsi

  Bular ILMIY so'zlar (hayvon va odam
  uchun).

  Oddiy nutqda:
     a woman / a man
     a girl / a boy

  'female human' — o'zga sayyoraliklarning
  ilmiy tili.


DIQQAT — 'THIS HERE':
  'And THIS HERE is a male human.'

  'this here' — so'zlashuv shakli
  ('mana bu').
  Rasmiy inglizchada shunchaki 'this'.


DIQQAT — 'A HUMAN':
  'a human' = odam (biologik tur sifatida)
  'a human being' — to'liq shakl
  'humans' = odamlar

  'a person' — oddiy so'z (kishi).


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  female  = urg'ochi, ayol jinsi
  male    = erkak jinsi
  a human = odam (tur sifatida)

2-KADR:

  ALIEN 1: 'And what was that metal box they
            were in?'
  ALIEN 2: 'They call it a car. Very primitive
            means of transport.'

  Tarjimasi:
  1: 'Ular ichida bo'lgan o'sha metall quti
      nima edi?'
  2: 'Ular uni "mashina" deb atashadi. Juda
      ibtidoiy transport vositasi.'


3-KADR:

  ALIEN 1: 'We have studied similar humans
            before. They are still very
            primitive. They will not be able
            to understand our technology.'
  ALIEN 2 (boshliq): 'They are not ready to
            join us. Erase their memories and
            send them back.'

  Tarjimasi:
  1: 'Biz ilgari shunga o'xshash odamlarni
      o'rganganmiz. Ular hali ham juda
      ibtidoiy. Ular bizning
      texnologiyamizni tushuna olmaydi.'
  2: 'Ular bizga qo'shilishga tayyor emas.
      Xotiralarini o'chiring va ularni
      qaytarib yuboring.'


⚠ UNIT 15 GRAMMATIKASI HIKOYADA:

  'We HAVE STUDIED similar humans BEFORE.'

  → PRESENT PERFECT!
  Vaqt AYTILMAGAN + 'BEFORE' → tajriba.

  Grammar 66-bet, 7-mashq:
     'Sophie has never been to the opera
      BEFORE.'
     'I have never been fishing BEFORE.'

  'before' — tajriba haqidagi gaplarda
  Present Perfect bilan keladi.


⚠ WORKBOOK 60-BET BILAN BOG'LIQ:

  'Very PRIMITIVE means of transport.'

  Workbook 60-bet, 3-mashqning 1-bandi
  AYNAN shu edi:
     'Canoes are a PRIMITIVE MEANS OF
      TRANSPORT.'

  Kitob mashqda oldindan bergan!


⚠ 1-EPIZODDAGI BAShORATNING JAVOBI:

  'ERASE their MEMORIES and send them back.'

  Workbook 60-bet, 3-mashqning 6-bandi:
     'The aliens ERASED their MEMORIES.'

  111-bet, 10-mashqdagi bashorat savoliga
  javob shu.


DIQQAT — 'A MEANS OF TRANSPORT':
  'a means of transport' = transport vositasi

  ⚠ 'MEANS' — birlikda ham, ko'plikda ham
  '-S' bilan!
     'a meanS of transport'  (BIRLIK)
     'two meanS of transport' (KO'PLIK)

  'a mean' degan shakl YO'Q (bu ma'noda).


DIQQAT — 'WILL NOT BE ABLE TO':
  'They WILL NOT BE ABLE TO understand.'
  = tushuna olmaydi

  'can' ning KELAJAK shakli:
     hozir:   'They CAN'T understand.'
     kelajak: 'They WON'T BE ABLE TO
              understand.'

  Chunki 'will can' — XATO!
     'will can understand'      ✗
     'will be able to understand' ✓


DIQQAT — 'TO BE READY TO':
  'They are not READY TO JOIN us.'
  'ready TO + fe'l' = ... ga tayyor


DIQQAT — 'SEND THEM BACK':
  'to send somebody BACK' = qaytarib
  yubormoq

  Ajraladigan fe'l:
     send them back  ✓
     send back them  ✗ (olmosh bilan faqat
                        o'rtada)


DIQQAT — 'STILL':
  'They are STILL very primitive.'
  'still' = hali ham

  O'rni: 'to be' fe'lidan KEYIN,
  boshqa fe'llardan OLDIN:
     'They ARE STILL primitive.'
     'They STILL LIVE here.'


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a metal box   = metall quti
  primitive     = ibtidoiy
  a means of transport = transport vositasi
  to study      = o'rganmoq
  similar       = o'xshash
  still         = hali ham
  to be able to = qila olmoq
  technology    = texnologiya
  ready to      = ... ga tayyor
  to join       = qo'shilmoq
  to erase      = o'chirib tashlamoq
  a memory      = xotira
  to send back  = qaytarib yubormoq

exercises.explanationUz:
4-KADR — BIR NEChA SOATDAN KEYIN JIPDA:

  SANDRA: 'What's wrong with this car, David?'
  DAVID:  'I don't know. ... Ah! It's okay.
           It's started now!'

  Tarjimasi:
  SANDRA: 'Bu mashinaga nima bo'ldi, Devid?'
  DEVID:  'Bilmayman... Voy! Yaxshi. Endi
           yurdi!'


5-KADR:

  SANDRA: 'That's strange. The film is full of
           pictures. Did we take any? I don't
           remember. Do you?'
  DAVID:  'No, I don't, but I can see the
           camera is on automatic. Let's
           develop the film and see what's in
           it.'

  Tarjimasi:
  SANDRA: 'G'alati. Plyonka suratlarga to'la.
           Biz surat oldikmi? Eslay olmayapman.
           Sen eslaysanmi?'
  DEVID:  'Yo'q, eslamayman, lekin
           fotoapparat avtomatik rejimda
           ekanini ko'ryapman. Kelinglar,
           plyonkani yuvaylik va ichida nima
           borligini ko'raylik.'


⚠ XOTIRA O'ChIRILGANI KO'RINADI:

  4-kadr: Sandra 'What's WRONG with this car?'
     deb so'raydi — 1-epizodda ham aynan shu
     bo'lgan edi ('There is something wrong
     with the car').

     Ular NIMA BO'LGANINI ESLAMAYDI.

  5-kadr: 'Did we take any? I DON'T REMEMBER.'

     Xotira o'chirilgani ochiq aytiladi.


⚠ 1-EPIZOD BILAN AYNAN TAKRORLANISh:

  1-epizod, 3-kadr:
     'There is something WRONG with the car.'
  2-epizod, 4-kadr:
     'What's WRONG with this car, David?'

  Kitob ataylab bir xil gapni takrorlagan —
  hikoya AYLANIB qaytganini ko'rsatish uchun.


DIQQAT — 'IT'S STARTED':
  'It'S STARTED now!' = It HAS started

  → PRESENT PERFECT!
  Natijasi HOZIR muhim (mashina yurdi).

  DIQQAT: 'It's' bu yerda 'it IS' emas,
  'it HAS':
     'It's started' = it HAS started
     'It's okay'    = it IS okay

  Qaysi ekanini keyingi so'z aytadi
  (Grammar 64-bet qoidasi).


DIQQAT — 'DID WE TAKE ANY?':
  'Did we take ANY?' = biror surat oldikmi?

  SAVOLDA 'any' ishlatiladi:
     'Did we take ANY pictures?'  ✓
     'Did we take SOME pictures?' — taklif
        ma'nosida bo'lardi


DIQQAT — 'DO YOU?':
  Sandra: 'I don't remember. DO YOU?'
  = Sen eslaysanmi?

  QISQA SAVOL asosiy gapdagi yordamchi
  fe'lni takrorlaydi:
     'I DON'T remember. DO you?'

  Grammar 63-bet, 9-mashqning 11-bandi:
     'I can't swim. CAN you?'

  Devidning javobi ham qisqa:
     'No, I DON'T.'


DIQQAT — 'LET'S':
  'LET'S develop the film and see ...'
  'let's' = let us → taklif

  'let's' dan keyin ASOSIY shakl:
     'Let's DEVELOP'  ✓
     'Let's TO develop' ✗


DIQQAT — 'TO DEVELOP A FILM':
  'to develop a film' = plyonkani yuvmoq
  (fotosuratni chiqarish)

  'develop' ning boshqa ma'nosi —
  'rivojlantirmoq'.


DIQQAT — 'ON AUTOMATIC':
  'the camera is ON AUTOMATIC'
  = fotoapparat avtomatik rejimda

  Shuning uchun suratlar o'z-o'zidan
  olingan — bu hikoyaning KALITI!


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  What's wrong with ...? = ... ga nima bo'ldi?
  to start (a car) = yurmoq (mashina)
  strange     = g'alati
  a film      = plyonka; kino
  full of     = ... ga to'la
  to remember = eslamoq
  a camera    = fotoapparat
  on automatic = avtomatik rejimda
  to develop a film = plyonkani yuvmoq
  Let's ...   = kelinglar, ...aylik

exercises.explanationUz:
6-KADR — MEHMONXONADA:

  DAVID:  'Sandra, you won't believe this.'
  SANDRA: 'What? A spaceship? Aliens? But
           how? When? What happened?'
  DAVID:  'My dear Sandra, I can't answer
           these questions, but there is one
           thing I'm sure about. This is going
           to be our best story.'

  Tarjimasi:
  DEVID:  'Sandra, bunga ishonmaysan.'
  SANDRA: 'Nima? Kosmik kema? O'zga
           sayyoraliklar? Lekin qanday?
           Qachon? Nima bo'ldi?'
  DEVID:  'Azizim Sandra, bu savollarga javob
           bera olmayman, lekin bir narsaga
           ishonchim komil. Bu bizning eng
           yaxshi maqolamiz bo'ladi.'


RASMDA:
  Devid qo'lida suratlarni ushlab turibdi,
  devorda esa NUJO surati osilgan
  (kattalashtirilgan).


⚠ HIKOYANING YAKUNI — TAAJJUBLI BURILISh:

  O'zga sayyoraliklar xotiralarini
  o'chirishdi, LEKIN fotoapparat avtomatik
  ishlab, suratlarni olib qolgan.

  Ya'ni:
     XOTIRA — yo'q
     DALIL  — bor

  Bu — hikoyaning badiiy 'burilishi' (twist).


⚠ HIKOYA BOShIGA QAYTADI:

  1-epizod, kirish:
     'They are doing some research TO WRITE A
      STORY about UFOs.'

  2-epizod, oxiri:
     'This is going to be OUR BEST STORY.'

  Ular maqola yozish uchun kelgan edi —
  va oxirida haqiqatan ham maqola oldi.


⚠ KELAJAK ZAMONNING UCh ShAKLI BIR KADRDA:

  'You WON'T BELIEVE this.'
     → WILL (bashorat)

  'This IS GOING TO BE our best story.'
     → BE GOING TO (dalilga asoslangan
       bashorat — suratlar qo'lida!)

  Unit 13 dan:
     WILL — dalilsiz bashorat
     BE GOING TO — DALIL bor bashorat

  Devid suratlarni ko'rgani uchun 'going to'
  ishlatadi — dalil qo'lida!


DIQQAT — 'YOU WON'T BELIEVE THIS':
  'You WON'T BELIEVE this!' = bunga
  ishonmaysan!

  Bu — hayajonli xabarni boshlash uchun
  turg'un ibora.

  'won't' = will not.


DIQQAT — SANDRANING QISQA SAVOLLARI:
  'What? A spaceship? Aliens? But how? When?
   What happened?'

  Bu — HAYAJON belgisi: to'liq gap tuzishga
  ulgurmaydi, faqat savol so'zlari.

  Komikslarda his-tuyg'uni ko'rsatish usuli.


DIQQAT — 'ONE THING I'M SURE ABOUT':
  'there is one thing I'm sure ABOUT'
  = bir narsaga ishonchim komil

  'to be sure ABOUT something' — predlog
  'about'.

  PREDLOG GAP OXIRIDA qoladi:
     'one thing I'm sure ABOUT'
  To'liq shakli: 'one thing ABOUT WHICH I'm
  sure' (juda rasmiy).


DIQQAT — 'MY DEAR SANDRA':
  'my dear' = azizim
  Iliq, do'stona murojaat.


DIQQAT — 'THE BEST':
  'our BEST story' — ustun daraja.
  good → better → THE BEST.

  Unit 15 da bu qurilma ko'p uchradi:
     'the best place I've ever visited'


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  You won't believe this = bunga ishonmaysan
  an alien    = o'zga sayyoralik
  What happened? = nima bo'ldi?
  my dear     = azizim
  to answer   = javob bermoq
  to be sure about = ... ga ishonchi komil
                     bo'lmoq
  our best story = eng yaxshi maqolamiz

exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

  1  →  c  (BECAUSE)   — KITOBDA STRELKA
  2  →  e  (BUT)
  3  →  g  (SO)
  4  →  a  (BECAUSE)
  5  →  d  (SO)
  6  →  b  (BUT)
  7  →  f  (BECAUSE)


TO'LIQ GAPLAR:

 1  'David and Sandra are driving near
     Myrrhee BECAUSE they want to write a
     story about UFOs.'
    (KITOBDA STRELKA CHIZILGAN)

 2  'The jeep slows down, BUT Sandra and
     David don't know why.'

 3  'They see a spaceship, SO David asks
     Sandra to take some pictures.'

 4  'The aliens take them into the spaceship
     BECAUSE they want to study them.'

 5  'The aliens think David and Sandra are
     very primitive, SO they erase their
     memories and send them back.'

 6  'David finds the film is full of
     pictures, BUT he doesn't remember using
     the camera.'

 7  'They are surprised when they see the
     pictures BECAUSE they are pictures of
     aliens and a spaceship.'


⚠ UCh BOG'LOVChINING FARQI:

  BECAUSE = chunki (SABAB)
     [natija] BECAUSE [sabab]
     'They are driving BECAUSE they want to
      write a story.'

  SO = shuning uchun (NATIJA)
     [sabab] SO [natija]
     'They see a spaceship, SO David asks
      Sandra to take pictures.'

  BUT = lekin (QARAMA-QARShILIK)
     [1-fikr] BUT [zid fikr]
     'The jeep slows down, BUT they don't
      know why.'


⚠ 'BECAUSE' va 'SO' — TESKARI TARTIB:

  Bir xil ma'noni ikki xil aytish mumkin:

     'They see a spaceship, SO David asks
      Sandra to take pictures.'
            ↑sabab      ↑natija

     'David asks Sandra to take pictures
      BECAUSE they see a spaceship.'
            ↑natija        ↑sabab

  Ya'ni 'so' va 'because' TARTIBI teskari!


HAR BIRI NEGA:

 1  'driving near Myrrhee' + 'they want to
    write a story'
    Haydashning SABABI → BECAUSE.

 2  'The jeep slows down' + 'they don't know
    why'
    Bu — QARAMA-QARShILIK (sekinlashdi,
    LEKIN sababi noma'lum) → BUT.

 3  'They see a spaceship' + 'David asks
    Sandra to take pictures'
    Kemani ko'rish — SABAB;
    surat olish — NATIJA → SO.

 4  'The aliens take them into the spaceship'
    + 'they want to study them'
    Olib kirishning SABABI → BECAUSE.

 5  'The aliens think they are primitive' +
    'they erase their memories'
    Fikr — SABAB; xotirani o'chirish —
    NATIJA → SO.

 6  'David finds the film is full of
    pictures' + 'he doesn't remember using
    the camera'
    QARAMA-QARShILIK (suratlar bor, LEKIN
    eslamaydi) → BUT.

 7  'They are surprised' + 'they are pictures
    of aliens'
    Hayronlikning SABABI → BECAUSE.


⚠ MANTIQIY ZANJIR (hikoya tartibida):
  1 → 2 → 3 → 4 → 5 → 6 → 7

  Bandlar hikoyaning KETMA-KETLIGIDA
  berilgan — bu ham yordam beradi.


DIQQAT — 'REMEMBER USING':
  'he doesn't remember USING the camera'
  'remember + -ING' = qilganini eslamoq

  (1b-mashqda ham shu qoida bor edi.)


DIQQAT — 'ASK SOMEBODY TO DO':
  'David ASKS Sandra TO TAKE some pictures.'
  'ask somebody TO do something' — kimdandir
  biror ishni qilishni so'ramoq.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a linking word = bog'lovchi
  because     = chunki
  so          = shuning uchun
  but         = lekin
  to study    = o'rganmoq
  to use      = foydalanmoq

     camel         (hayvon)

     aeroplane     (dvigatel)
     train         (dvigatel)
     car           (dvigatel)
     hot air balloon (zamonaviy uchish
                      apparati)


QANDAY AJRATILADI:

  IBTIDOIY — HAYVON yoki ODAM kuchi bilan
     harakatlanadi, dvigatel YO'Q:
        cart — ot tortadi
        rowing boat — odam eshkak eshadi
        raft — daryo oqimi olib ketadi
        camel, donkeys — hayvonning o'zi

  ZAMONAVIY — MAShINA/DVIGATEL bilan:
        aeroplane, train, car

  DIQQAT — HAVO ShARI:
     Havo sharida dvigatel yo'q (issiq havo
     ko'taradi), lekin u ZAMONAVIY sanoat
     mahsuloti va zamonaviy uchish apparati
     hisoblanadi.

     Ba'zilar uni 'primitive' deb ham
     tasniflashi mumkin — bu munozarali.


⚠ BOG'LIQLIK — HIKOYA VA WORKBOOK:

  112-bet, 2-kadr:
     'They call it a car. Very PRIMITIVE

DIQQAT — 'A MEANS OF TRANSPORT':

DIQQAT — 'DONKEYS' KO'PLIKDA:
  Ro'yxatda 'donkeys' (ko'plik) berilgan,

DIQQAT — 'A RAFT' va 'A ROWING BOAT':
  a raft = sol (bog'langan yog'ochlar)
  a rowing boat = eshkakli qayiq

  Ikkalasi ham suv transporti, lekin sol
  oddiyroq.


DIQQAT — 'A CART':
  a cart = arava (hayvon tortadigan)
  a carriage = arava (yo'lovchi uchun,
     chiroyliroq)
  a wagon = yuk aravasi


GAP TUZISh:
  'A cart is a primitive means of transport.'
  'An aeroplane is a modern means of
   transport.'
  'Camels and donkeys are primitive means of
   transport.'


YANGI SO'ZLAR:

  an aeroplane  = samolyot
  a train       = poyezd
  a donkey      = eshak
  a camel       = tuya
  a rowing boat = eshkakli qayiq

⚠ QIZIQ NUQTA — HAVO ShARI:

  Havo shari (hot air balloon) MODERN
  guruhiga kiritilgan.

  ⚠ Lekin birinchi odamli havo shari

  MAShINADAN ham OLDIN!

  ⚠ Kitob 'modern' deganda bugungi

exercises.explanationUz:
MATN — MYRRHEE HAQIDA HAQIQIY MA'LUMOT.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

   1  IS
   2  SAY
   3  HAVE SEEN
   4  IS
   5  ARE ALIENS
   6  COMPARED
   7  SUGGESTED
   8  KNEW
   9  IS
  10  LIVED
  11  ARRIVED
  12  DID THEY KNOW
  13  DID ALIENS TRY
  14  DON'T KNOW
  15  IS
  16  IS


TO'LIQ MATN (javoblar bilan):

  'Myrrhee IS a small place near the town of
   Moyhu in New South Wales, Australia. Many
   people SAY they HAVE SEEN UFOs in the
   area, but the big question IS this — why
   ARE ALIENS interested in Myrrhee?

   In the late 1960's, Erich von Däniken
   COMPARED some ancient Aboriginal rock
   paintings to modern descriptions of
   aliens. They SUGGESTED that the ancient
   Aborigines KNEW about aliens. Another
   interesting point IS that many Aborigines
   LIVED around the area of Myrrhee before
   the white man ARRIVED in the 18th century.
   DID THEY KNOW about aliens? DID ALIENS TRY
   to contact the Aborigines again?
   Unfortunately, we DON'T KNOW for sure. One
   thing IS certain, though — the truth IS
   still out there ...'


TO'LIQ TARJIMASI:

  'Myrrhee — Avstraliyaning Yangi Janubiy
   Uels shtatidagi Moyhu shahri yaqinidagi
   kichik joy. Ko'p odamlar bu hududda
   NUJOlarni ko'rganini aytadi, lekin katta
   savol shu — nega o'zga sayyoraliklar
   Myrrhee bilan qiziqadi?

   1960-yillarning oxirida Erix fon Deniken
   ba'zi qadimiy aborigen qoya rasmlarini
   o'zga sayyoraliklarning zamonaviy
   tasviriga qiyoslagan. Ular qadimgi
   aborigenlar o'zga sayyoraliklar haqida
   bilgan deb taxmin qilishgan. Yana bir
   qiziq jihat shundaki, oq tanlilar 18-asrda
   kelishidan oldin ko'plab aborigenlar
   Myrrhee atrofida yashagan. Ular o'zga
   sayyoraliklar haqida bilganmi? O'zga
   sayyoraliklar aborigenlar bilan yana
   aloqaga chiqmoqchi bo'lganmi? Afsuski,
   biz aniq bilmaymiz. Ammo bir narsa
   aniq — haqiqat hali ham qayerdadir...'


ZAMONLAR BO'YIChA GURUHLAR:

  PRESENT SIMPLE (doimiy haqiqat) —
     1, 2, 4, 5, 9, 14, 15, 16

  PRESENT PERFECT (tajriba, vaqt yo'q) —
     3

  PAST SIMPLE (o'tmish) —
     6, 7, 8, 10, 11, 12, 13


HAR BIRI NEGA:

 1  'Myrrhee ... a small place'
    Doimiy haqiqat → PRESENT SIMPLE. → IS

 2  'Many people ... they ...'
    Doimiy holat → PRESENT SIMPLE. → SAY

 3  'they ... UFOs in the area'
    ⚠ Vaqt AYTILMAGAN, TAJRIBA →
    PRESENT PERFECT. → HAVE SEEN
    (110-bet, 2-kadr: 'some people say they
     HAVE SEEN UFOs' — AYNAN bir xil!)

 4  'the big question ... this'
    → IS

 5  'why ... interested in Myrrhee?'
    Savol, hozirgi holat → ARE ALIENS

 6  'In the LATE 1960'S, Erich von Däniken
    ...'
    ANIQ VAQT → PAST SIMPLE. → COMPARED

 7  'They ... that the ancient Aborigines...'
    O'sha vaqtda → PAST SIMPLE. → SUGGESTED

 8  'the ancient Aborigines ... about aliens'
    QADIMDA → PAST SIMPLE.
    know → KNEW.

 9  'Another interesting point ... that ...'
    Hozirgi fikr → PRESENT SIMPLE. → IS

10  'many Aborigines ... around the area'
    O'tmishda → PAST SIMPLE. → LIVED

11  'before the white man ... in the 18TH
    CENTURY'
    ANIQ VAQT → PAST SIMPLE. → ARRIVED

12  '... about aliens?'
    O'tmish haqida savol → PAST SIMPLE.
    → DID THEY KNOW

13  '... to contact the Aborigines again?'
    O'tmish haqida savol → PAST SIMPLE.
    → DID ALIENS TRY
    ('HAVE ALIENS TRIED' ham mumkin —
     bugungi kungacha bo'lgan davr uchun.)

14  'we ... for sure'
    Hozirgi holat → PRESENT SIMPLE.
    → DON'T KNOW

15  'One thing ... certain'
    → IS

16  'the truth ... still out there'
    → IS


⚠ 3-BAND — UNIT 15 GRAMMATIKASI:
  'they HAVE SEEN UFOs in the area'

  Vaqt AYTILMAGAN → PRESENT PERFECT.

  110-bet, 2-kadr:
     'some people say they HAVE SEEN UFOs'

  Kitob AYNAN shu gapni takrorlagan!


⚠ 12 va 13-BANDLAR — SAVOL ShAKLI:
  'DID they KNOW ...?'
  'DID aliens TRY ...?'

  'DID' dan keyin ASOSIY shakl:
     'Did they KNOW?'  ✓
     'Did they KNEW?'  ✗


DIQQAT — 'THE 18TH CENTURY':
  'in the 18th century' = 18-asrda
  O'qilishi: 'the eighteenth century'.

  Asrlar DOIM 'the' bilan.


DIQQAT — 'FOR SURE':
  'we don't know FOR SURE' = aniq bilmaymiz
  Turg'un ibora.


DIQQAT — 'THOUGH':
  'One thing is certain, THOUGH.'
  'though' bu yerda = 'ammo, lekin'
  va GAP OXIRIDA turadi.

  Grammar 62-bet, 6-mashqdagi xatda ham bor
  edi: 'I'm worried THOUGH, that ...'


DIQQAT — 'THE TRUTH IS OUT THERE':
  Bu — mashhur 'The X-Files' serialining
  shiori.

  'out there' = qayerdadir tashqarida


DIQQAT — 'ABORIGINES':
  Bet ostida kitob izoh bergan:
  '* Aborigines - the original people of
   Australia'
  = Avstraliyaning tub aholisi

  'aboriginal' — sifat shakli.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  New South Wales = Yangi Janubiy Uels
                    (Avstraliya shtati)
  an area      = hudud
  interested in = ... bilan qiziquvchi
  in the late 1960's = 1960-yillar oxirida
  to compare ... to ... = ... ni ... ga
                 qiyoslamoq
  ancient      = qadimiy
  Aborigines   = Avstraliya tub aholisi
  a rock painting = qoya rasmi
  a description = tasvir, ta'rif
  to suggest   = taxmin qilmoq
  a point      = jihat, fikr
  the white man = oq tanlilar
  the 18th century = 18-asr
  to contact   = aloqaga chiqmoq
  unfortunately = afsuski
  for sure     = aniq
  certain      = aniq, shubhasiz
  though       = ammo (gap oxirida)
  the truth    = haqiqat
  out there    = qayerdadir

⚠⚠ ESKIRGAN ATAMA — 'ABORIGINES':

  Matnda Avstraliyaning tub aholisi
  'Aborigines' deb atalgan.

  ⚠ Bu so'z OT sifatida bugungi
  Avstraliyada QO'POL hisoblanadi.

  ⚠ Bugungi to'g'ri variantlar:
     Aboriginal people
     Aboriginal Australians
     First Nations people
     Indigenous Australians

  ⚠ SIFAT sifatida 'Aboriginal' hamon
  TO'G'RI: 'Aboriginal rock paintings'
  (matnda shunday ham ishlatilgan).

  ⚠ Kitob 2000-yillar boshida chiqqan;
  o'shanda bu so'z keng ishlatilardi.


⚠ USLUB XATOSI — 'In the late 1960'S':

  Kitobda o'n yillik APOSTROF bilan
  yozilgan.

  ⚠ To'g'ri yozilishi — '1960s',
  APOSTROFSIZ.

  ⚠ Apostrof faqat EGALIK ('Tom's') yoki
  QISQARTMA ('don't') uchun ishlatiladi,
  ko'plik uchun EMAS.
